stages.label: Inquiry
stages.summary: Customer request is captured: product, metal, stones, references, budget and delivery date.

stages.label: CAD Design
stages.summary: CAD designer builds the 3D model from the brief and uploads versions for review.
checklist: Stone sizes and proportions match specs

stages.label: Design Approval
stages.summary: The design is reviewed; revisions are requested or the version is approved and locked.

stages.label: Pricing
stages.summary: Bill of materials is costed: metal, gemstones, labour, setting and certification.

stages.label: Final Approval
stages.summary: Customer approves the final design and price; the job is released to manufacturing.

stages.label: Wax / 3D Print
stages.summary: The approved CAD is 3D printed in castable wax/resin and inspected.

stages.label: Casting
stages.summary: The wax is invested, burnt out and cast in the chosen alloy.

stages.label: Assembly
stages.summary: Sprues are removed, parts cleaned up, pre-polished and assembled at the bench.

stages.label: Stone Setting
stages.summary: Center and accent stones are set and secured.

stages.label: Polishing
stages.summary: Final polishing and finishing (high polish, matte, texture) as specified.

stages.label: Quality Control
stages.summary: Final inspection against the approved CAD, dimensions, weight, stone security and finish.

stages.label: Certification
stages.summary: Stones / piece are sent to a gem lab (IGI, GIA, HRD) and the certificate is logged.

stages.label: Dispatch
stages.summary: Secure packing, insurance and courier manifest; the piece is shipped.

stages.label: Delivered
stages.summary: The piece is received by the jeweler or customer.
